schema: CREATE TABLE course (course_id INT PRIMARY KEY, dept_name TEXT, credits INT); CREATE TABLE department (dept_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
correct_query: SELECT c.dept_name, SUM(c.credits) FROM course AS c INNER JOIN department AS d ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name GROUP BY c.dept_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.credits) > 2

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT c.dept_name, SUM(c.credits) FROM course AS c INNER JOIN department AS d ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name GROUP BY c.dept_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.credits) > 5
